title: Amazing, I would highly recommend it.
text:
This was amazing. The church was incredible.
Our guide was good. The only downside was the meeting place. The directions were not clear. The meeting place was outside of the Hard Rock across the street from the church, but the directions did not say that.
author: 261jeanner

title: Great experience
text: The tour was great. I especially appreciated our tour guide Cristina’s expertise on the history of Gaudi, Sagrada, and its relation to Catholicism and faith. It really made the experience more meaningful and did Gaudi’s amazing work a lot of justice. I got emotional seeing the interior of Sagrada Familia and the tour made it memorable. Thank you so much.
author: jakef892

title: Birthday visit
text: Thank you for elevating our birthday celebration with a professional tour in the Sagrada Familia. We had a truly fantastic experience.

title: Outstanding tour!

title: Sagrada small group tour
text:
Meeting point was near the Hard Rock Cafe.  This information was not clearly communicated, only an address was given.  As the Metro had multiple exits, it took us awhile to find the proper meeting place.   
The guide was excellent and gave us a very interesting tour.  Our group of 12 seemed to enjoy the tour.  We did have to wait a long time in line to get in through the TSA type screening point as there were a lot of groups going through.  Having radios inside was very helpful.
author: dramap
